pricing.counts.title: What counts as an email cleared
pricing.counts.body: Archiving or deleting an email you already have counts as 1 email cleared.
Unsubscribe, Keep, Later, previews and Undo never count.
If you undo, those emails count toward that month’s free total again.
Your {freeName} total resets on your signup date each month. {BILLING_NAME} shows the date.

pricing.faq.charged.a: {freeName} never charges you. The {passName} is a single payment and never renews. {plusName} renews once a year until you cancel, and you can cancel any time in {BILLING_NAME}.
pricing.faq.charged.a.passOff: {freeName} never charges you. {plusName} renews once a year until you cancel, and you can cancel any time in {BILLING_NAME}.
pricing.faq.refunds.a: Yes. Ask within {refundDays} days of any charge and we refund it in full, once per customer. Email support@declutrmail.com with “refund” in the subject.
pricing.faq.passEnds.a: You’re back on {freeName}. Email you already cleared stays where you put it, and you can clear {allowance} more emails a month for free. Nothing renews, and you can buy another {passName} any time.
pricing.faq.taxes.a: Paddle is our merchant of record, so it calculates and collects any sales tax or VAT at checkout. You see the final amount before you pay.
pricing.faq.india.q: What do you charge in India?
pricing.faq.india.a: In India, prices are in rupees and include GST: {plusPrice} a year for {plusName} and {passPrice} once for the {passName}. You can pay with UPI.
pricing.promise.title: Our price promise
pricing.promise.keep: If we change prices, existing subscribers keep their price for as long as they stay subscribed. If we lower a price, you get the lower price at your next renewal.
pricing.promise.pass: The {passName} is a one-time payment and never renews.
pricing.promise.free: We’ll never lower the free monthly limit on an existing account.
pricing.changelog.intro: Every change to DeclutrMail’s prices and plans, newest first.
pricing.changelog.entry.2026-10-27: Launch pricing: {freeName} with {allowance} emails cleared a month, {passName} {passPrice} once, {plusName} {plusPrice} a year with up to {plusInboxes} {CONNECTION_TERM_PLURAL}.
refunds.summary: Every purchase comes with a {refundDays}-day money-back guarantee, once per customer. If DeclutrMail isn’t working out, tell us within {refundDays} days of being charged and we’ll refund that charge in full. You can cancel any time and keep access until the end of the period you paid for. Refunds go back to your original payment method.
refunds.cancelNoRefund: Canceling on its own doesn’t trigger a refund. If you also want your money back, the {refundDays}-day guarantee in Section 3 covers it.
refunds.window: Refund requests made within {refundDays} days of a charge (your first purchase, a renewal or a {passName}) are refunded in full. This applies to every paid plan.
refunds.pass: If we refund a {passName}, its {passDays} days of {plusName} end when the refund is confirmed and your account returns to {freeName}. Email you already cleared stays where you put it.
refunds.oncePerCustomer: The money-back guarantee can be used once per customer. Statutory refund rights in your country (for example, EU consumer withdrawal rights) are not limited by this policy.
refunds.exclusions.window: Charges older than the {refundDays}-day guarantee window in Section 3, except where law requires.
refunds.exclusions.second: A second use of the money-back guarantee. It can be used once per customer.
refunds.india: New purchases in India go through Paddle, in rupees with GST included, and Paddle’s buyer terms apply. If you bought through Razorpay before, DeclutrMail is your seller: request a refund from us at support@declutrmail.com and approved refunds go back through Razorpay to your original payment method.
terms.plans: DeclutrMail offers a {freeName} plan, a one-time {passName}, and a yearly {plusName} subscription. Current pricing and what each plan includes are shown at purchase time. Subscriptions renew automatically until canceled; you can cancel at any time and keep access until the end of the period you paid for.
terms.pass: The {passName} is a one-time payment for {passDays} days of {plusName} and never renews. Buying another {passName} adds {passDays} days to the end of your current one.
terms.india: In India: new purchases are processed by Paddle, our merchant of record, in rupees with GST included. Subscriptions bought earlier through Razorpay continue under DeclutrMail as the seller.
terms.pastDue: A subscription marked past due keeps subscription access for up to 14 days after its billing period ends.
